[F001] All three auditor probes now resolve correctly. The full targeted suite (25 tests) is green. No side-effect commands beyond the test run were invoked.

$ PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_review_lint_f001.py -q

**Finding 1 (high — `missing_prereq` only checked backticked tokens):** Rewrote `extract_named_tokens` to scan the *raw AC prose* in addition to backtick spans. Two new plain-text scanners now fire: `_PLAIN_FLAG_RE` catches any unambiguous `--name` flag (double-dash only, so hyphenated prose like "round-trip" is never mis-read), and `_PLAIN_SYMBOL_RE` catches dotted (`mod.fn`) and snake_case (`missing_symbol`) identifiers anywhere in the text. Extraction is de-duplicated across both sources via a `seen` set. I excluded filename-like dotted tokens (`decisions.jsonl`) via `_FILE_EXT_RE` and prose abbreviations (`e.g`/`i.e`) via `_SYMBOL_STOPWORDS` to avoid false positives, and deliberately kept bare command words backtick-scoped (an undelimited lowercase word is indistinguishable from prose). The auditor's exact probe now returns `[('--nonexistent','flag'), ('missing_symbol','symbol')]`. Added `test_plain_text_flag_and_symbol_flag_missing_prereq` (positive), `test_plain_text_resolved_symbol_does_not_flag` and `test_plain_text_filename_is_not_a_symbol` (negatives).
